'''T-11''' was a [[JV-Z1/S DataBank Droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a military tactics strategist. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], T-11 was reassigned to controlling a [[Garbage scow/Legends|garbage scow]]. Due to error with reprogramming the droid, T-11 began to suffer from a form of "psychoses" and paranoia. T-11 eventually wound up in the service of the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]].
